# April 28, 2023 all-hands: format that worked

The open Q&A attempt did not get the room participating: the first half hour was largely silent. We stopped that format halfway through and switched to a demo-day-style show-and-tell. Each team got **5 minutes** to present.

The short, team-by-team show-and-tell worked better: people started talking and engaging. Compared with the Q&A attempt, it gave the room a concrete prompt and a clear turn for each team rather than relying on people to volunteer questions.
